policies.doi_tra: Cua hang ho tro doi/tra trong 7 ngay ke tu khi nhan hang neu san pham con nguyen tem mac, chua qua su dung. Hang sale tren 50%, my pham da mo niem phong va do ca nhan khong ho tro doi/tra.
policies.phi_ship: Mien phi giao hang toan quoc cho don tu 500,000 VND. Don duoi 500,000 VND ap dung phi ship dong gia 30,000 VND.
policies.bao_hanh: San pham dien tu ap dung bao hanh theo thoi han ghi trong du lieu san pham. Loi do roi vo, vao nuoc hoac su dung sai huong dan khong duoc bao hanh mien phi.
policies.huy_don: Chi co the huy don khi don con o trang thai dang xu ly hoac da dong goi nhung chua ban giao cho don vi van chuyen.
policies.hoan_tien: Hoan tien ve phuong thuc thanh toan ban dau trong 3-5 ngay lam viec sau khi kho xac nhan da nhan hang hoan.
